priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Everson, a designee of Toby Neugebauer, did not serve on any committee of the Board at the time of his resignation. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.
